items.briefing:
Mid-sized Australian organisations should be on high alert, with new data showing firms of this size account for 73% of ransomware victims globally — making them a prime target. Separately, a new unfiltered AI platform called "Kriminal" is lowering the barrier for cybercriminals to craft attacks, meaning threats may become more frequent and harder to spot. A ransomware group linked to Clop has also been exploiting a vulnerability in Windchill software, so any organisation using that platform should check with their IT team urgently.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation hasn't tested its data backups recently, do it this week — reliable backups are your best defence if ransomware strikes.

featured.title: Retailers widen security role beyond loss prevention
featured.summary: Security teams are increasingly being used to improve efficiency, safety and compliance as retailers seek more value from ageing systems.
